title: Canonical uncompleted local stalk comparison
statement: Let f:X→Y be proper, Y locally Noetherian, F coherent, y∈Y and p≥0 [def-weil-proper-morphism, pqf-def-locnoeth, pqf-def-coherent]. Write A=O_(Y,y) and H=H^p(Spec(A)×_Y X,g′*F) as an A-module [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-local-comparison]. There exists an A-linear equivalence a:(R^p f_*F)_y→H satisfying IsFormalFunctionsLocalComparison [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-local-comparison], i.e. it sends each germ of a neighbourhood cohomology class to its pullback to the local base change. No quotient system or completed cohomology comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tag 02OD (lemma-formal-functions-stalk), proof before the final application of Theorem 02OC, coherent.tex lines 5759-5798; Tag 02KH (lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology), Tag 01E4 and Tag 089W. The omitted identifications and transition compatibilities are expanded in steps 1-7 of lem-weil-pbc-formal-functions-stalk.

proof.text: (The local ring and the canonical morphism.) Put $A=\mathcal O_{Y,y}$, $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak m_y$. As $Y$ is locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], $y$ lies in an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}R$ with $R$ Noetherian, and $A\cong R_{\mathfrak p}$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-local-ring-canonical-morphism] is Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian]; so $Y'=\operatorname{Spec}A$ is locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $c:Y'\to Y$ be the canonical morphism and $y'$ the closed point of $Y'$. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-local-ring-canonical-morphism]: $c$ is flat, $c(y')=y$, $c^{-1}(V)=Y'$ for every open $V\ni y$, the stalk map $\mathcal G_y\to(c^*\mathcal G)_{y'}$ is an isomorphism for every $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal G$, and $c_n=c\circ c'_n$ with $c'_n:\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^n)\to Y'$ the closed immersion given by the quotient map (part (5) with $J=\mathfrak m^n$). This is 'c is a flat morphism as it identifies local rings' and the hint 'the morphisms $c_n$ factor through $c$' of the source. In Lean the Noetherian stalk ring is provided by the Mathlib instance for a locally Noetherian scheme.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 02OD (lemma-formal-functions-stalk, lines 5759-5800)

proof.text: On the locally Noetherian source, coherence gives quasi-coherence and finite type. The canonical local spectrum has Noetherian local ring and the proper base change is locally Noetherian. Pullback is quasi-coherent and finite type, hence coherent; the flat-base-change theorem needs its quasi-coherence, not a finite-level surjectivity assertion.

(The stalk is $H^p(X',\mathcal F')$.) Define $\varphi:M\to H:=H^p(X',\mathcal F')$ by $\varphi([\xi]_V)=(g'_V)^*\xi$ for $\xi\in H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)$, where $g'_V:X'\to f^{-1}(V)$ is $g'$ (Step 2) and $(g'_V)^*$ the pullback [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] (b) (with $(g'_V)^*(\mathcal F|_{f^{-1}V})=\mathcal F'$); it is well defined because pullback commutes with restriction to smaller $V$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap-functorial] (2),(3), and $A$-linear, $A=\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ acting on $H$ through $A=\Gamma(Y',\mathcal O_{Y'})\to\Gamma(X',\mathcal O_{X'})$ (linearity in [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap], $c^\sharp$ inducing the identity of $A$ on stalks, Step 1). $\varphi$ is bijective: let $G=R^pf_*\mathcal F$ and $G'=R^pf'_*\mathcal F'$. By flat base change (Stacks Tag 02KH, directly; the current Lean declaration of lem-pc-flat-base-change-cohom is only a field-extension finrank result and does not supply this isomorphism) ($c$ flat, $f$ qcqs, $\mathcal F$ quasi-coherent) the base change map $\beta:c^*G\to G'$ is an isomorphism ($g'$ is flat as a base change of $c$, so the base change map of Stacks 02N7 is defined). By [lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-map-sections] its adjoint $\beta^\flat=c_*(\beta)\circ\eta_G:G\to c_*G'$ sends $[\xi]_V$ to the class of $(g'_V)^*\xi$ in $G'(c^{-1}V)=G'(Y')$. Take stalks: the composite $G_y\to(c^*G)_{y'}\xrightarrow{\beta_{y'}}G'_{y'}$, whose first arrow is the isomorphism of Step 1 (germ of the unit $\eta_G$), sends $[\xi]_V$ to the germ at $y'$ of the class of $(g'_V)^*\xi$, so it is an isomorphism. Finally $G_y=M$ and $G'_{y'}=\varinjlim_{W\ni y'}H^p(f'^{-1}W,\mathcal F')=H^p(X',\mathcal F')$ [lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-presheaf], [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], since $Y'$ is the only open of $Y'$ containing the closed point $y'$ of the local scheme (an open containing $\mathfrak m$ contains every prime of $A$, all being generalizations of $\mathfrak m$). Under these identifications the composite is $\varphi$; hence $\varphi$ is an isomorphism of $A$-modules (Stacks: $c^*R^pf_*\mathcal F=R^pf'_*\mathcal F'$ by 02KH, and $(R^pf'_*\mathcal F')_{y'}=\Gamma(Y',R^pf'_*\mathcal F')=H^p(X',\mathcal F')$; the stalk route used here avoids the affine-base lemma 01XK). (Linearity and the degree-0 description of these maps: [lem-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap-basic-properties].) This gives the linear equivalence and the canonical local germ comparison predicate, with every resolution and every open comparison choice quantified. No finite quotient system is asserted.

from.place: Canonical uncompleted local stalk comparison in the geometric reduction of the formal-functions input to henselian idempotent lifting.

lean.statement:
theorem formalFunctions_local_stalk_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (y : Y) (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : formalFunctionsStalk f y F p ≃ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y]
      formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p,
      IsFormalFunctionsLocalComparison f y F p a.toLinearMap
